title_en: ‘South of Midnight’ developer Compulsion Games becomes independent from MS Xbox
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Game Industry Biz reported on the 21st (local time) that Compulsion Games became independent from its parent company Microsoft (MS) Xbox and converted into an independent studio. This independence was carried out by the management directly acquiring the studio's shares and its personnel. According to the report, Guillaume Provot, CEO of Compulsion Games, said, "We pursued this acquisition to protect the team," and added, "The team members also had a firm will to remain together rather than splitting up." He added, "Compared to the risk of layoffs amid large-scale workforce reductions in July, this is a very positive result, and MS has also opened a smooth exit." Through this independence, Compulsion Games regained all IP (intellectual property rights) and publishing rights for its existing titles, including 2013's 'Contrast', 2018's 'We Happy Few', and 2025's 'South of Midnight'. Publishing rights will be completely transferred to Compulsion Games after a transition period for each platform. Compulsion Games is seeking partnerships with various investment sources to secure its own viability in the future. summary_source: [지디넷코리아]현대자동차그룹이 경남 거제·통영 등 집중호우 피해 지역의 복구와 이재민 지원을 위해 성금 10억원을 전달했다.현대차그룹은 희망브리지 전국재해구호협회에 성금 10억원을 기탁했다고 23일 밝혔다. 성금은 피해 지역의 신속한 복구와 수해 주민 지원에 쓰일 예정이다.현대차그룹은 성금 기탁과 함께 세탁구호차량 3대를 현장에 투입한다. 침수 등으로 오염된 세탁물을 처리할 수 있도록 지원하기 위해서다.수해 피해 차량 고객을 위한 지원도 마련했다. 자차보험에 가입하지 않은 고객이 피해 사실 확인서를 제출하고 차량을 입고하면 수리비를 최대 50% 할인한다.현대차는 승용차 최대 300만원, 상용차 최대 500만원까지 지원하며, 기아는 승용·상용차 모두 최대 300만원 한도다. 수리 완료 후에는 무상 세차 서비스도 제공한다.현대차그룹 관계자는 "갑작스러운 집중호우로 큰 피해를 입은 모든 분들께 깊은 위로의 말씀을 드린다"며 "성금과 구호차량 투입 등의 지원이 조금이나마 도움이 되기를 바란다"고 말했다.현대차그룹은 지난해 경남 산청과 경기 가평 등 집중호우 피해 지원을 위해 성금 20억원을 전달했다. 이밖에 경상권·울산 산불과 집중호우, 강릉 산불, 울진·삼척 산…

summary_ja: 現代自動車グループが慶尚南道巨済・統営など集中豪雨被害地域の復旧とイ・ジェミン支援のために寄付金10億ウォンを伝達した。寄付金は被害地域の迅速な復旧と水害住民支援に使われる予定だ。浸水などで汚染された洗濯物を処理できるように支援するためだ。 水害被害車両顧客のための支援も設けた。自車保険に加入していない顧客が被害事実確認書を提出し、車両を入庫すれば修理費を最大50％割引する。修理完了後は無償洗車サービスも提供する。 現代車グループの関係者は「突然の集中豪雨で大きな被害を受けたすべての方々に深い慰めのお言葉を差し上げる」とし「募金と救護車両投入などの支援が少しでも役に立つことを願う」と話した。 現代車グループは昨年、 20億ウォンを渡した。このほか、慶尚圏・蔚山山火事と集中豪雨、江陵山火事、蔚津・三che山…

title_en: KT opens AI future camp for 100 elementary school students with Seoul city
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] KT announced on the 22nd that it held the 'AI Future Camp with KT-Seoul City' for 100 elementary school students in the Seoul area at the Seoul Robot Artificial Intelligence Science Center in Dobong-gu, Seoul. The participating students were divided into 4 groups of 25 people and participated in 5 programs on topics such as AI technology and ethics, robot experience, coding, and digital crime prevention. Students attended KT's mobile AI experience education center 'AI I experienced AI technology and ethics at 'Station' and learned the basic principles of AI through 'AICE Future', a block coding education linked to the AI qualification test AICE. At the Seoul Robot Artificial Intelligence Science Museum, I visited the 'Thinking Robot and Human Asking Questions' exhibition and experienced the 'Picabot Art Museum' where I draw pictures using a robot arm. Through the 'AI Utilization Crime Prevention Training' conducted by the Seoul Dobong Police Station, they also learned digital safety rules necessary in everyday life. Through this, KT established a public-private cooperation AI education model that combines private company AI technology, Seoul city public infrastructure, and police crime prevention education. In the future, we plan to expand AI education opportunities by expanding cooperation with national and public science museums, local governments, and public institutions.
